summary.text: Your MediShield Life premium subsidy eligibility is generally valid for one year.

details.heading: Validity Period
details.body: In general, your subsidy eligibility will be valid for one year. Your subsidy eligibility may be updated when there are changes to your household information, such as a new-born in your household or when you apply for / renew your status under other healthcare subsidy schemes such as the Community Health Assist Scheme (CHAS).
